channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Bluey: The Videogame
item.description: Play a brand-new story set across 4 interactive adventures, explore iconic locations, play your favourite games from the TV show and also play with your friends and family in local multiplayer.

item.title: Brick Rigs
item.description: Build your own vehicles or download one of the more than 200,000 creations already uploaded to the Workshop and experience the dynamic driving and destruction physics of Brick Rigs!

item.title: Bunny Guys!
item.description: Climb, fall, curse… uh, respawn, pretend it was intentional. Bunny Guys is pure parkour chaos where one wins and everyone else fails spectacularly. Perfect for players who treat suffering, respawning, and “I can do better” as a hobby.

item.title: Bunny Hurling
item.description: Hunt the bunnies, load the catapult and hurl them… The King demands.

item.title: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
item.description: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut is a groundbreaking role playing game. You’re a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal and a whole city to carve your path across. Interrogate unforgettable characters, crack murders or take bribes. Become a hero or an absolute disaster of a human being.

item.title: Granvir
item.description: Granvir is a 3rd person action roguelite mech-builder with co-op multiplayer. Scavenge the battlefield for parts to replace and upgrade your Granvir and weaponry. PIlot your Granvir and manage your campaign between battles to find the best equipment and stay supplied while fighting a guerilla war.

item.title: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes
item.description: The stage is set. Imagine an old baroque manor, perhaps a hotel or a museum, somewhere in central Europe. A woman wanders in search of answers.

item.title: Machinarium
item.description: Machinarium is the award-winning independent adventure game developed by the makers of Samorost series, Botanicula and CHUCHEL. Help Josef the robot save his girlfriend Berta kidnapped by the Black Cap Brotherhood gang!

item.title: MENACE
item.description: Lead a strike force against an alien threat in this turn-based tactical RPG from the developers of Battle Brothers. Answer distress calls across different worlds, train and equip infantry, deploy tanks and mechs, and plan and execute missions in detailed turn-based battles.

item.title: Nova Roma
item.description: The glory of Rome is at your fingertips in this city-building game where you must appease the gods, enact laws, and develop complex supply chains to meet the needs of your citizens.

item.title: Old World
item.description: Old World is a revolutionary new historical strategy game where you lead your dynasty over generations of rule against rival kings and queens. Wage massive wars, manage your court, and build a dynasty — or watch your empire crumble to dust. What legacy will you leave behind?

item.title: Out of the Park Baseball 27
item.description: 27 years of sports gaming excellence! Out of the Park Baseball 27 is here - officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO! You are firmly in charge of your favorite baseball franchise - today or at any point in history! Your team, your way, your rules.

item.title: Outer Wilds
item.description: Named Game of the Year 2019 by Giant Bomb, Polygon, Eurogamer, and The Guardian, Outer Wilds is a critically-acclaimed and award-winning open world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop.

item.title: Outer Wilds - Echoes of the Eye
item.description: A strange satellite photo that can’t be explained. A new museum exhibit that marks the trailhead for one last journey into the wilds. Should you pull at the thread and unravel the solar system’s deepest secret, or is some knowledge better left in the dark?

item.title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Enhanced Edition
item.description: Embark on a journey to a realm overrun by demons in a new epic RPG from the creators of the critically acclaimed Pathfinder: Kingmaker. Explore the nature of good and evil, learn the true cost of power, and rise as a Mythic Hero capable of deeds beyond mortal expectations.

item.title: Possible One: Lunar Industries
item.description: Stake your claim in the first realistic lunar colony management game! Use proven, real-world technologies to plan and grow your colony, mine resources, ship them to Earth, and keep the board of directors happy in this science-based colony sim.

item.title: TEKKEN 8
item.description: TEKKEN 8 is the latest addition to the TEKKEN series, the pinnacle of 3D fighting games. Join the fight with over 32 characters and bear witness to the next installment in this epic saga. Get ready for the biggest and best TEKKEN game ever made!

item.title: The Temple of Elemental Evil
item.description: Years ago a demoness’s elemental cult ruled from a temple near Nulb until the Circle of Eight razed it. Now bandits stalk Hommlet and dark forces gather at the ruins. In this classic party‑based D&D RPG, unmask their true purpose and confront the reborn evil before chaos engulfs the land.

item.title: Xenonauts 2
item.description: Wage a global war of resistance against an alien invasion. Command turn-based tactical battles, build a network of covert bases, directly control your fighter wings, and achieve strategic victory in a simulation of asymmetric warfare against a technologically superior foe.

item.title: The Rebirth Tale of Broken Horn Demon Lord Alice
item.description: To exact revenge on the Brave, the reckless Demon Lord Alice, after her rebirth, decides to proceed cautiously, step by step. To weaken the brave's forces, she must defeat the Four Sages and expand her territory.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Chaos Space Marines
item.description: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius is back with a new playable faction, the Chaos Space Marines.Fueled by their hatred for the Imperium, they will stop at nothing before they exact their revenge. Fielding hellish machines, wielding Warp powers and possessing the experience of a thousand wars, these ancient warriors are ready to conquer Gladius...

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Demolition Pack
item.description: 11 new units are ready to enter the battle for Gladius Prime with the Demolition Pack!These new units are ready to demolish all the enemies’ defenses and they will give you more new strategic options.

item.title: KILLER INN
item.description: KILLER INN is a fast-paced asymmetrical PvP shooter where you eliminate the killers (the wolves) in battle—no time for discussion or voting! Choose the right weapons, abilities, and build. Gather clues, identify the wolves, then take them down with force!

item.title: Risk of Rain (2013)
item.description: Risk of Rain is an action platformer with roguelike elements. With permanent death as a primary feature, players will have to play their best to get as far as possible. Fight on a mysterious planet with randomly spawning enemies and bosses, either alone or with 3 friends in online co-op.

item.title: Sultan's Game
item.description: Survive a mad Sultan's reign in this brutal resource management RPG. Draw a card every seven days and complete its challenge. Make dreadful choices to stay alive: will you die a loyal servant, become a kingslayer, or call down the gods' judgement?

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Orks
item.description: The most warlike race in the Galaxy, Orks live for the joy of battle and are always chasing their next big Waaagh! They arrive in Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector with fifteen super-killy units that are all armed to da teef and overflowing with Dakka!

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Onslaught Pack
item.description: Deploy 8 brand-new units with the Onslaught Pack on the battlefields of Gladius Prime. The new units will bring a new offensive layer and will unlock new strategic options for commanders.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - T'au
item.description: The T’au Empire joins the fight for the domination of Gladius Prime. Driven by a constant ambition to expand and spread the word of the Greater Good across the Galaxy, they will seek to assimilate or eliminate all the other opposition races on the planet.

item.title: .hack//G.U. Last Recode
item.description: .hack//G.U. is back! This collection includes all 3 original .hack//G.U. titles, Rebirth, Reminisce, and Redemption, all fully restored and remastered. As well as an all new 4th Volume: .hack//G.U. Reconnection.

item.title: Digimon World: Next Order
item.description: The Digital World has run rampant with Machinedramon and is now in a state of utter chaos. As a Digidestined, it’s up to you to restore order to the world in Digimon World: Next Order, a monster collecting RPG.

item.title: Ghost Janitors
item.description: Ghost Janitors is a multiplayer psychological horror game for 1-4 players. Your job? Cleaning haunted houses while avoiding terrifying monsters. Ready to face the spine-tingling challenge with your team?

item.title: GUNDAM BREAKER 4
item.description: Create your own ultimate Gundam in the newest Gundam Breaker! With more customizable parts than ever before, you finally have the freedom to build your perfect Gunpla. Test it in battle using the brand new dual-weapon system and break parts off of your enemies and add them to your collection.

item.title: Jurassic World Evolution
item.description: Place yourself at the heart of the Jurassic franchise and build your own Jurassic World. Bioengineer dinosaurs that think, feel and react intelligently to the world around them and face threats posed by espionage, breakouts and devastating tropical storms in an uncertain world where life always finds a way.

item.title: NARUTO X BORUTO Ultimate Ninja STORM CONNECTIONS
item.description: Legendary ninjas reunite in the next exciting entry of the STORM series! NARUTO X BORUTO Ultimate Ninja STORM CONNECTIONS is an action/fighting game with fast-paced ninja battles and two different story modes.

item.title: NICE TO MEET YOU, AGAIN
item.description: NICE TO MEET YOU, AGAIN is a dramatic story by veteran visual novel developer, Purple software. How would you rewrite your life if given the chance to travel 13 years in to the past?

item.title: Pathfinder: Kingmaker — Enhanced Plus Edition
item.description: Pathfinder: Kingmaker - Enhanced Plus Edition is the first isometric party-based cRPG set in the Pathfinder fantasy universe. Enjoy a classic RPG experience inspired by games like Baldur's Gate, Fallout 1 and 2 and Arcanum. Explore and conquer the Stolen Lands and make them your kingdom!

item.title: Retail Hell
item.description: Trapped in an infinite shift, you are the sole clerk of purgatory’s only convenience store. Manage stock, pay your taxes and keep nightmarish creatures at bay as you uncover the secret of why your shift never ends. Clock in. Serve the dead. Survive the shift.

item.title: Saints Row
item.description: Welcome to Santo Ileso, a vibrant fictional city in the American Southwest. In a world rife with crime, where lawless factions fight for power, a group of young friends embark on their own criminal venture, as they rise to the top in their bid to become Self Made.

item.title: Saints Row IV: Re-Elected
item.description: Experience the insane antics of Saints Row IV. The Saints have gone from the Penthouse to the White House - but Earth has been invaded and it’s up to you to save it with an arsenal of superpowers and strange weapons, in the wildest open world game ever.

item.title: Saints Row: The Third
item.description: Get ready for the most out-landish gameplay scenarios ever seen as the Third Street Saints take on the Syndicate!

item.title: Saints Row®: The Third™ Remastered
item.description: The Full Package, Remastered – With enhanced graphics, improved lighting, reworked environments, and visual effects, Steelport and The Third Street Saints have never looked so good.

item.title: Sherlock Holmes The Awakened
item.description: Experience a nerve-racking Lovecraftian adventure, rebuilt from the ground up with modern graphics and gameplay. Become Sherlock Holmes, and find yourself at the heart of the terrifying Cthulhu Mythos as you investigate a series of mysterious disappearances in Europe and the US.

item.title: SOULCALIBUR VI
item.description: Bring more than your fists to the fight! Featuring all-new battle mechanics and characters, SOULCALIBUR VI marks a new era of the historic franchise. Welcome back to the stage of history!

item.title: SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream
item.description: Introducing the 2nd installment for the 10th anniversary of SWORD ART ONLINE! A total of 21 characters from the series join the battle beyond memory—a challenge taken on solo or with friends. Go beyond memory... and Switch!

item.title: TEKKEN 7
item.description: Discover the epic conclusion of the long-time clan warfare between members of the Mishima family. Powered by Unreal Engine 4, the legendary fighting game franchise fights back with stunning story-driven cinematic battles and intense duels that can be enjoyed with friends and rivals.

item.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 4
item.description: The fourth pack in this storied party game franchise features Fibbage 3 and its new game mode, Fibbage: Enough About You; the twisted web game Survive the Internet; the dating contest Monster Seeking Monster; the deranged debate match Bracketeering; and the one-up art game Civic Doodle.

item.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 6
item.description: It’s the wildest Party Pack yet, with the absurd deathmatch Trivia Murder Party 2, the weird word circus Dictionarium, the hidden identity game Push The Button, the comedy contest Joke Boat and the offbeat personality test Role Models.

item.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 8
item.description: Plan your next game night! Jackbox Games is back with 5 hilarious new party games including Drawful Animate, Job Job, The Poll Mine, Weapons Drawn, and The Wheel of Enormous Proportions.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER - Chaos Warriors
item.description: The Chaos Warriors Race Pack brings a new race with its own new Legendary Lords, units, mounts, items, quest chains and mechanics to Total War™: WARHAMMER®.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER - The Grim and the Grave
item.description: Total War: WARHAMMER – The Grim & The Grave The Grim & The Grave is the first Lords Pack for Total War: WARHAMMER. Bolstering the forces of both The Empire and The Vampire Counts, it introduces famous rival characters and new iconic units from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles to your campaigns and battles.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER - The King and the Warlord
item.description: The King & The Warlord is the second Lords Pack for Total War: WARHAMMER. Bolstering the forces of both The Greenskins and The Dwarfs, it introduces famous rival characters, new iconic units and new battle maps from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles to your Grand Campaigns and Custom/Multiplayer battles.Two new Legendary Lords….

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II - The Hunter & The Beast
item.description: The Hunter & The Beast is the latest Lords Pack for Total War: WARHAMMER II. Introducing two rival Legendary Lords from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles, each with their own objectives, mechanics, units and playstyle, for use in both the Eye of the Vortex and Mortal Empires campaigns, and custom/multiplayer battles.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II - The Queen & The Crone
item.description: The Queen & the Crone is the first Lords Pack for Total War: WARHAMMER II. Bolstering the forces of the High Elves and the Dark Elves, it introduces famous rival characters and new iconic units from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles to your campaigns and battles.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II - The Shadow & The Blade
item.description: The Shadow & The Blade is the latest Legendary Lords Pack for Total War: WARHAMMER II. Introducing Malus Darkblade and Deathmaster Snikch both with their own objectives, mechanics, units and playstyle,

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II - The Silence & The Fury
item.description: This Lords Pack for Total War: WARHAMMER II introduces two new Legendary Lords for the Lizardmen and the Beastmen, bringing new features, units, unique gameplay mechanics and narrative objectives.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II - The Warden & The Paunch
item.description: The Warden & the Paunch is the latest Lords Pack for Total War: WARHAMMER II. Introducing two rival Legendary Lords from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles, each with their own factions, objectives, mechanics, units and playstyle.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War III
item.description: Step into a brutal battle between three warring factions In Dawn of War III you will have no choice but to face your foes when a catastrophic weapon is found on the mysterious world of Acheron.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Adepta Sororitas
item.description: A new faction joins the war for Gladius Prime: the Adepta Sororitas, with eighteen new units and unique gameplay mechanics.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Adeptus Mechanicus
item.description: A new faction joins the war for Gladius Prime. The Adeptus Mechanicus are an empire within the Imperium, with their own agenda, their own god (‘The Omnissiah’) and their own fanatical purpose—the discovery of knowledge, of technology.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Drukhari
item.description: The Drukhari are an ancient race that fell into degeneracy and depravity, with their remnants only surviving in immense Webway cities.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Rampage Pack
item.description: Deploy 8 brand-new units with the Rampage Pack on the battlefields of Gladius Prime. The new units will bring a new offensive layer and will unlock new strategic options for commanders.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Tyranids
item.description: On Gladius Prime there is only war. Orks, Necrons and Men vie for control of a dying world. But something worse lurks in the shadows. Feral Tyranids now roam the planet's surface, escapees from an Imperial research facility. All life on Gladius will shudder in fear. For the Great Devourer comes.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Ultima Founding
item.description: The Primaris are ready to step in the battle for the God Emperor and the Holy Throne. Eight new units and unique gameplay mechanics will give you more options for the fight for Gladius Prime.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - Black Templars Champion Pack
item.description: Forever crusade against the enemies of Humanity with the Black Templars Champion Pack, granting you a unique full-body Power Armour skin for the Bulwark class and a Power Sword skin featuring the colours and iconography of the Black Templars.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - Raven Guard Champion Pack
item.description: Strike from the darkness with the Raven Guard Champion Pack! Fast and lethal, this DLC grants you an exclusive Raven Guard Champion skin for the Assault class and a unique Bolt Pistol weapon skin. This DLC is available as part of the Season Pass 2.

item.title: Warhammer: End Times - Vermintide
item.description: Vermintide is an epic co-operative action combat adventure set in the End Times of the iconic Warhammer Fantasy world.

item.title: ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN
item.description: Become an ace pilot and soar through photorealistic skies with full 360 degree movement; down enemy aircraft and experience the thrill of engaging in realistic sorties! Aerial combat has never looked or felt better!

item.title: BLEACH Rebirth of Souls
item.description: Awaken the blade within you and reverse your fate in BLEACH Rebirth of Souls! Engage in thrilling battles with powerful sword abilities and characters from this legendary anime franchise.

item.title: Blood Bowl 3
item.description: Brutal, crazy, tactical… this is BLOOD BOWL! The iconic death sport returns with the new video game of fantasy football faithfully using the latest board game rules and new content. Create your team, then crush, mulch and cheat your way to the top... leaving your opponents in the graveyard.

item.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2018
item.description: Build and expand your repair service empire in this incredibly detailed and highly realistic simulation game, where attention to car detail is astonishing. Find classic, unique cars in the new Barn Find module and Junkyard module. You can even add your self-made car in the Car Editor.

item.title: CODE VEIN II
item.description: An epic adventure awaits, where you and your chosen partners explore a post-apocalyptic world, face fierce battles against powerful enemies, and uncover an epic story that transcends time.

item.title: Diablo II: Resurrected – Infernal Edition
item.description: Rediscover the dark fantasy classic that defined the modern ARPG genre; fully remastered with a new class, fresh content, quality‑of‑life upgrades, and an overhauled endgame. Chain brutal skill and item synergies, rise in power, and carve through Hell’s armies with up to eight players.

item.title: Elemental: Reforged
item.description: A 4X strategy game in a fantasy RPG world. Create your own sovereign hero, build a dynasty, design custom units, and wage turn-based war across a world that's different every time you play. Every unit is an individual with their own name, gear, and story.

item.title: Elite Dangerous
item.description: Take control of your own starship and blaze your trail in an ever-changing galaxy. Master the arts of combat, mining and trade or venture out into the unknown across a 1:1 scale universe.

item.title: Frostpunk
item.description: Frostpunk is the first society survival game. As the ruler of the last city on Earth, it is your duty to manage both its citizens and infrastructure. What decisions will you make to ensure your society's survival? What will you do when pushed to breaking point? Who will you become in the process?

item.title: GRIP: Combat Racing
item.description: Harness gravity-defying speed in classic combat racing taken to the EXTREME. Master wall-riding, ceiling-surfing tracks, and unleash devastating weapons across 29 blistering circuits. Race solo, split-screen, or online with up to 10 players. GRIP delivers white-knuckle racing like nothing else.

item.title: House Flipper 2
item.description: Clean your worries away with this relaxing renovation simulator! Buy, fix, sell, and become a local legend. Or grab your power tools and build anything from scratch! With the online 2-4 players co-op mode, you can play both in sandbox and story mode together.

item.title: Hozy
item.description: Restore a forgotten neighbourhood through your favourite hobby, one cozy room at a time. In Hozy, clean, paint, and decorate abandoned homes with satisfying mechanics and intuitive controls. Enjoy the little details as you interact with tools, items and furniture to bring each space back to life.

item.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R
item.description: Hirohiko Araki's masterpiece, brought to life as a fighting game! Battle with 50 colorful characters, wielding Stands, Hamon, and more! See how characters who could never meet in the story interact when they come face to face!

item.title: Jurassic World Evolution 2
item.description: Jurassic World Evolution 2 is the much-anticipated sequel to Frontier’s highly successful Jurassic World Evolution. This bold new era in the Jurassic World Evolution game franchise builds upon the ground-breaking and immersive 2018 management simulation.

item.title: Lethal Company
item.description: A co-op horror about scavenging at abandoned moons to sell scrap to the Company.

item.title: Mordheim: City of the Damned
item.description: Mordheim: City of the Damned is the first video game adaptation of Games Workshop's cult classic tabletop game Mordheim. Set in the Warhammer World's decimated Empire city, Mordheim: City of the Damned is a turn-based tactical game where you lead warbands into bloody and lethal skirmishes.

item.title: MÖRK BORG Heresy Supreme
item.description: A desperate attempt to endure the coming Apocalypse in a cursed, unjust dark fantasy world, made only to appease a vain god. Combat is brutal, choices are lethal, and survival is a temporary insult to fate. A flail to the face.

item.title: NARUTO TO BORUTO: SHINOBI STRIKER
item.description: Battle as a team of 4 to compete against other teams online! Graphically, SHINOBI STRIKER is also built from the ground up in a completely new graphic style. Lead your team and fight online to see who the best ninjas are!

item.title: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4
item.description: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 is the latest evolution of PIRATE WARRIORS action! Based on the concept of "experiencing a real ONE PIECE battlefield," buildings will come crashing down during the action and attacks will throw up smoke and dust, placing you in the thick of the ONE PIECE world!

item.title: Planet Coaster
item.description: Planet Coaster® - the future of coaster park simulation games has arrived! Surprise, delight and thrill incredible crowds as you build your coaster park empire - let your imagination run wild, and share your success with the world.

item.title: Planet Coaster 2
item.description: Build and customise thrilling roller coasters and incredible water slides, manage the ultimate theme park experience, and share your epic creations. Are you ready to ride the wave?

item.title: Planet Coaster 2: Sorcery Pack
item.description: Enchant your guests with the spellbinding Sorcery Pack – create a world of magic and wonder, where five thrilling rides, fantastical characters, and towering gothic spires await!

item.title: Planet Coaster 2: Toybox Pack
item.description: Unbox the fun with the Toybox Pack! Turn your park into a playful wonderland packed with five sensational rides, larger-than-life toys, and colourful cities, built block-by-block straight from your childhood.

item.title: Planet Zoo
item.description: Build a world for wildlife in Planet Zoo. From the developers of Planet Coaster and Zoo Tycoon comes the ultimate zoo sim. Construct detailed habitats, manage your zoo, and meet authentic living animals who think, feel and explore the world you create around them.

item.title: Potion Craft: Alchemist Simulator
item.description: Potion Craft is an alchemist simulator where you physically interact with your tools and ingredients to brew potions. You're in full control of the whole shop: invent new recipes, attract customers and experiment to your heart's content. Just remember: the whole town is counting on you.

item.title: Restaurats
item.description: Lead a medieval restaurant with a team of rats like you! Cook the food, throw it at the guests, wipe the drinks under the skeletons! Become a legendary rat chef, proving to orcs and vampires that the most delicious bloody meat is served in your restaurant!

item.title: Risk of Rain 2
item.description: Escape a chaotic alien planet by fighting through hordes of frenzied monsters – with your friends, or on your own. Combine loot in surprising ways and master each character until you become the havoc you feared upon your first crash landing.

item.title: Risk of Rain 2: Alloyed Collective
item.description: Lured, enslaved, and left to rust. The Alloyed Collective now stirs from the scrap of their fallen allies, driven by a singular purpose: returning home. Master two new Survivors and descend deep into Petrichor V to take on the Alloyed Collective’s ultimate creation.

item.title: Risk of Rain 2: Seekers of the Storm
item.description: An ancient threat awakens on Petrichor V. Master new Survivors, wield new items, and fight your way across uncharted regions. Ascend the levels of the Colossus in a race to confront The False Son. Defeat him and unlock the true power of his Soul!

item.title: Risk of Rain 2: Survivors of the Void
item.description: Embrace The Void as it overtakes Petrichor V in Risk of Rain 2’s first-ever expansion! New survivors, monsters, stages, and a new class of items have arrived to help you kick the crabs back to their dimension.

item.title: Risk of Rain Returns
item.description: Carefully designed, beautifully remastered, and loaded with new ways to play—Risk of Rain is back and better than ever! Dive into the iconic roguelike full of unique loot combinations, enhanced with new Survivors, overhauled multiplayer, fan favorite content from Risk of Rain 2, and more!

item.title: Rivals of Aether II
item.description: Rivals of Aether II is the sequel to the hit indie fighting game, Rivals of Aether. Play as both new and returning elemental fighters in the next generation of platform fighters.

item.title: Rust - Warhammer 40,000 Pack
item.description: The infamous Death Korps of Krieg march into Rust, bringing their grim, war-forged resolve to the island. This pack delivers battle-scarred war gear, inspired by one of Warhammer 40,000’s most fearless regiments.

item.title: Saleblazers
item.description: You’re a humble shopkeeper trying to live a peaceful new life, finding yourself surrounded by warring factions and dangerous creatures. Will you be able to carve out a new home for yourself and your customers in this open-world survival shopkeeping simulator?

item.title: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions
item.description: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions is a gamified focus tool, set to a soothing lofi soundtrack. Discover and collect Spirits, customize your cozy virtual space, and facilitate your real-life tasks with a collection of handy features designed to improve concentration and ease stress.

item.title: Sunderfolk
item.description: Rediscover game night in this tactical RPG where shared strategy shapes every turn. Adventure across the Sunderlands with up to four players in online multiplayer using your mouse & keyboard or play couch co-op using phones as controllers. Play the first 4 missions for free!

item.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 3
item.description: The threequel to the party game phenomenon features the deadly quiz show Trivia Murder Party, the say-anything sequel Quiplash 2, the surprising survey game Guesspionage, the t-shirt slugfest Tee K.O., and the sneaky trickster game Fakin’ It.

item.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 7
item.description: Five new games: the hit threequel Quiplash 3, the collaborative chaos of The Devils and the Details, the fierce drawing game Champ’d Up, the speech game Talking Points and the guessing game Blather 'Round. Use phones or tablets as controllers and play with up to 8 players, and an audience of 10,000!

item.title: The Outlast Trials
item.description: Red Barrels invites you to experience mind-numbing terror, this time with friends. Whether you go through the trials alone or in teams, if you survive long enough and complete the therapy, Murkoff will happily let you leave… but will you be the same?

item.title: The Sinking City Remastered
item.description: Powered by Unreal Engine 5, The Sinking City Remastered brings the eerie, atmospheric world of Oakmont back to life with enhanced gameplay and fully relit environments, perfect for both newcomers and returning players.

item.title: The Spotter: Dig or Die
item.description: Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER
item.description: Addictive turn-based empire-building with colossal, real-time battles, all set in a world of legendary heroes, giant monsters, flying creatures and storms of magical power.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER - Call of the Beastmen
item.description: Something stirs in the deep dark forests of The Old World… Call of the Beastmen adds a brand new playable Race to Total War: WARHAMMER: the Beastmen, alongside a host of other new features and mechanics. The pack also introduces a separate revenge-fuelled story campaign, An Eye for an Eye, featuring a bespoke campaign map and victory...

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER - Norsca
item.description: This DLC makes the Norsca Race playable, barbaric tribes that serve the dark gods through hunting and pillaging. Hardened by endless blizzards and monstrous beasts, they exist only to lay waste.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER - Realm of The Wood Elves
item.description: To outsiders, the forest realm of Athel Loren is a brooding and malicious place. The creak and groan of living wood echoes from its dim interior, the canopy seems to absorb all light, and half-seen spirits dart between the twilit bowers. To enter is to place your fate in their hands.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II
item.description: Strategy gaming perfected. A breath-taking campaign of exploration, expansion and conquest across a fantasy world. Turn-based civilisation management and real-time epic strategy battles with thousands of troops and monsters at your command.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II - Curse of the Vampire Coast
item.description: Dread prows pierce the gloom ahead, and the ghastly truth is laid bare: upon the ghoul-winds come the swollen hulks and decaying vessels of the Vampire Coast! Run now – run hard and fast. For it is all you can do.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II - Rise of the Tomb Kings
item.description: Across the arid deserts of Nehekhara, vast legions of skeletal warriors rise from beneath the baking sands to slaughter those who trespass into their domain.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II - The Prophet & The Warlock
item.description: The Prophet & The Warlock is the latest Lords Pack for Total War: WARHAMMER II. Introducing two rival Legendary Lords from the world of Warhammer Fantasy Battles, each with their own objectives, mechanics, units and playstyle.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II - The Twisted & The Twilight
item.description: This Lords Pack for Total War: WARHAMMER II introduces two new Legendary lords for the Skaven and the Wood Elves. Each leads their own faction and features new characters, units, unique gameplay mechanics and narrative objectives.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III
item.description: The cataclysmic conclusion to the Total War: WARHAMMER trilogy is here. Rally your forces and step into the Realm of Chaos, a dimension of mind-bending horror where the very fate of the world will be decided. Will you conquer your Daemons… or command them?

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Aislinn – Tides of Torment
item.description: The Sea Lord Aislinn DLC pack introduces master High Elf naval tactician Aislinn as a playable Legendary Lord. Commanding the Sea Patrol, he spearheads Ulthuan’s defence and expands its sea-borders.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Champions of Chaos
item.description: The Champions of Chaos Lords Pack introduces four new playable Legendary Lords to Total War: WARHAMMER III, usable in both the Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Dechala – Tides of Torment
item.description: The Dechala the Denied One DLC pack introduces the deadly Chaos Champion Dechala as a playable Legendary Lord. Leading The Tormentors, she wages campaigns of brutal exploitation worldwide.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Elspeth – Thrones of Decay
item.description: The ‘Elspeth – Thrones of Decay’ pack introduces Elspeth Von Draken, a new Legendary Lord for the Empire, usable in both the Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Forge of the Chaos Dwarfs
item.description: The Forge of the Chaos Dwarfs campaign pack introduces a new brutal race, the Chaos Dwarfs, into Total War: WARHAMMER III, in both the Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns. Expand, exploit, and dominate the Warhammer world as Astragoth Ironhand, Drazhoath the Ashen, and Zhatan the Black.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Golgfag – Omens of Destruction
item.description: The Golgfag Maneater DLC pack for Total War: WARHAMMER III introduces veteran mercenary Golgfag Maneater as a playable Legendary Lord alongside a deadly host of new battle units, gameplay features and objectives to be experienced in the immense Immortal Empires campaign or Custom Battles.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Gorbad – Omens of Destruction
item.description: The Gorbad Ironclaw DLC pack for Total War: WARHAMMER III introduces infamous Orc Warboss Gorbad Ironclaw as a playable Legendary Lord alongside a deadly host of new battle units, gameplay features and objectives to be experienced in the immense Immortal Empires campaign or Custom Battles.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Malakai – Thrones of Decay
item.description: The ‘Malakai – Thrones of Decay’ pack introduces Malakai Makaisson, a new Legendary Lord for the Dwarfs, usable in both the Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Mother Ostankya – Shadows of Change
item.description: This pack introduces Mother Ostankya, a new Legendary Lord for Kislev, usable in both Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns, as well as new units, characters, and regiments of renown.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Ogre Kingdoms
item.description: The first Race Pack for Total War: WARHAMMER III introduces the Ogres! Tough, vicious and driven by ravenous appetites, the Ogre tribes descend from the Mountains of Mourn, their greedy eyes fixed on faraway gold and the tantalising prospect of fresh meat…

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Sayl – Tides of Torment
item.description: The Sayl the Faithless DLC pack introduces the deceitful sorcerer Sayl as a playable Legendary Lord. Leading the Dolgan Tribe, Sayl is ruthless and self-serving when executing his manipulation of others.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Skulltaker – Omens of Destruction
item.description: The Skulltaker DLC pack for Total War: WARHAMMER III introduces Khorne’s Immortal Champion and the greatest of all Bloodletters, Skulltaker, as a playable Legendary Lord.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Tamurkhan – Thrones of Decay
item.description: The ‘Tamurkhan – Thrones of Decay’ pack introduces Tamurkhan the Maggot Lord, a new Legendary Lord for Nurgle, usable in both the Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - The Changeling – Shadows of Change
item.description: This pack introduces the Changeling, a new Legendary Lord for Tzeentch, usable in both Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns, as well as new units, characters, and regiments of renown.

item.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Yuan Bo – Shadows of Change
item.description: This pack introduces Yuan Bo, a new Legendary Lord for Grand Cathay, usable in both Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns, as well as new units, characters, and regiments of renown.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector
item.description: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game set in the grimdark universe of the 41st Millennium. Pick your force, develop your army, field mighty heroes and fight for victory using superior strategy, awesome abilities, and devastating weaponry.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Astra Militarum
item.description: Astra Militarum, the backbone of the Imperium’s might, are ready to fight in Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector. Sixteen new units are available to defend and fight for the Emperor.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Black Legion
item.description: The Black Legion are the latest faction to invade Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector. Fifteen new units bring the Warmaster’s wrath to the galaxy and devastation to all who stand in their way.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Deeds of the Fallen
item.description: Welcome to Warzone Chalnath — a volatile hotspot in the galaxy-wide conflict — where you take the battle to Thorakleo IV. Featuring 12 brand new missions and three new units for the Sisters of Battle.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate - Daemonhunters
item.description: Lead humanity’s greatest weapon, the Grey Knights, in this fast-paced turn-based tactical RPG. Root out and purge a galaxy-spanning plague in a cinematic, story-driven campaign, using the tactics and talents of your own personalised squad of Daemonhunters.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate - Daemonhunters - Execution Force
item.description: Unleash the power of the elite Officio Assassinorum! Command four new playable units with unparalleled skills. Stand firm against insidious Tentarus Hives on unsettling new maps and engage in intense new boarding missions against the corrupted Death Guard.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate - Daemonhunters - Duty Eternal
item.description: Experience thrilling new missions, a powerful additional class, and all-new ways to decimate the forces of Nurgle in the first major DLC for the critically-acclaimed tactical turn-based RPG.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Arbites Class
item.description: You are justice. The Adeptus Arbites enforce the Lex Imperialis – the Imperial Law. Utterly unforgiving, they persecute heretics and traitors throughout the Emperor’s realm. Restore order to Tertium with your Cyber-Mastiff and a devastating array of new weaponry.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Arbites Class Cosmetic Upgrade
item.description: You are justice. The Adeptus Arbites enforce the Lex Imperialis – the Imperial Law. Utterly unforgiving, they persecute heretics and traitors throughout the Emperor’s realm. Restore order to Tertium with your Cyber-Mastiff and a devastating array of new weaponry.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Hive Scum Class
item.description: The Hive Scum comes screaming from the depths of the hive, sowing destruction and mayhem in their wake. These dangerous cartel fixers represent the criminal powers that some say truly run Tertium.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Hive Scum Class Cosmetic Upgrade
item.description: The Hive Scum comes screaming from the depths of the hive, sowing destruction and mayhem in their wake. These dangerous cartel fixers represent the criminal powers that some say truly run Tertium.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition
item.description: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition is the ultimate Dawn of War experience, featuring the original Dawn of War and all its expansions, along with enhanced visuals, an improved camera, and 64-bit platform support.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
item.description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Fire Warrior (Classic)
item.description: Become an elite Fire Warrior and fight the forces of the Imperium of Man in an action-packed classic FPS. Experience Warhammer 40,000 from a unique T'au perspective with a story full of twists and betrayal.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Relics of War
item.description: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius – Relics of War brings you to a world of terror and violence. Four factions will engage in a brutal war for dominance over the planet’s resources. In the first turn-based 4X strategy game set in Warhammer 40,000 you will lead one of four unique factions.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Inquisitor - Martyr
item.description: Enter the Chaos-infested Caligari Sector and purge the unclean with the most powerful agents of the Imperium of Man! W40k: Inquisitor – Martyr is a grim Action-RPG featuring multiple classes of the Inquisition who will carry out the Emperor’s will.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus
item.description: MECHANICUS II ANNOUNCED! Take control of one of the most technologically advanced factions in the Imperium: the Adeptus Mechanicus. In this turn-based tactical game, your every decision will weigh heavily on the outcome of the conflict. Will you be blessed by the Omnissiah?

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus - Heretek
item.description: Opening a whole new plot line, Heretek exposes the dark underbelly of the Adeptus Mechanicus faction like never before.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus II
item.description: Fast-paced tactical combat meets strategic management in this sequel to the acclaimed Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus. Take control of either the ancient and deathless Necron legions or the techno-religious acolytes of the Omnissiah, with the fate of a world in your hands.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
item.description: Made in a close partnership with Games Workshop, Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader is a story-rich classical RPG from Owlcat Games, developers of the critically acclaimed game, Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Deluxe Pack
item.description: Gear up for Koronus Expanse with additional in-game items and digital goodies!

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Voidfarer Pack
item.description: Explore the Void with these additional in-game items!

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Shootas, Blood & Teef
item.description: From the developers of the Guns, Gore and Cannoli franchise comes a new 2D run & gun platformer: Warhammer 40,000: Shootas, Blood & TEEF! Spearhead an Ork invasion, destroy the hive city and kill your warboss! ‘Ere we go!

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Anniversary Edition
item.description: In Warhammer 40,000 Space Marine you are Captain Titus, a Space Marine of the Ultramarines chapter and a seasoned veteran of countless battles.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition
item.description: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine returns. Enhanced for a new generation! Enjoy quality of life & graphical improvements that take the Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine experience to the next level.

item.title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Realms of Ruin
item.description: Wage a campaign of brutal conquest in this realm-shattering real-time strategy game set in the Warhammer Age of Sigmar universe. Become a warlord and lead four unique factions to conquer the wild and savage Realm of Ghur in tense and tactical battles.

item.title: Warhammer: Mark of Chaos - Gold Edition (Classic)
item.description: Command the armies of the Empire, the Hordes of Chaos, Orcs & Goblins, and other iconic Warhammer Fantasy factions in massive real-time battles. Warhammer: Mark of Chaos is a classic RTS celebrated for its unprecedented scale and detail for its time.

item.title: AquaDream Soundtrack
item.description: The AquaDream Soundtracks pack includes the five original tracks from the game, composed by Joshua Liljeblad, along with their Reverb versions.

item.title: Dino running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM
item.description: Run, Dino, run — Mr. Furry is already close! Collect coins, avoid obstacles, unlock new costumes, and set records in a crazy 2.5D runner. Most importantly — do not let yourself get caught… it is better not to know what happens next.
